upgrade.lead: You can translate your menu into multiple languages so customers can view the menu in their language.
upgrade.body: Built for multilingual menus. Available on Pro and Premium plans (per-language editor, limits based on your subscription, and auto-translate in beta).
upgrade.cardTranslationsDesc: Manage languages per menu, flags on the menu, and edit text for each language.
upgrade.cardAutoDesc: Generate automatic drafts to save time; review and publish when ready.
upgrade.promoTitle: Upgrade to Pro or Premium and try translations plus many more features
upgrade.promoBody: Higher plans unlock multilingual menus, more capacity, and extra tools—compare options and pick what fits your business.

page.publicToggleHint: Use the Public menu switch on each language to show or hide it on the QR menu (it remains available in the editor even when hidden).
page.needBusiness: To create a menu translation you first need at least one business and one menu.
page.selectBusinessHint: Select a business to see its menus.
page.noMenus: There are no menus for this business.

menuCard.autoBadgeTitle: Auto-translate already run for this language
menuCard.publicToggleTitle: When off, the language does not appear on the public menu (it does in the editor)
menuCard.useAsDefaultTitle: This language’s content will become the menu’s canonical content

autoTranslate.title: Auto-translate (beta)
autoTranslate.help: Translates all text from {{source}} into the selected language. Monthly usage depends on your plan. You can edit afterwards under “Translate”.
autoTranslate.force: Force re-translate (uses one credit even if already translated)
autoTranslate.needLocale: Add at least one language other than {{source}}.
autoTranslate.confirmMessage: The menu will be translated from {{source}} to {{locale}}.{{forceNote}}{{extra}} Continue?
autoTranslate.forceNote: Force mode: uses one credit even if the menu already has a previous auto-translation.
autoTranslate.success: Done: {{segments}} segments. New API calls: {{apiUnits}}. Reused from cache: {{cacheHits}}.

addLocale.title: Add language
addLocale.intro: Current text from the base language ({{source}}) will be copied as a starting point. You can refine it later in the editor.
addLocale.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or code (e.g. catal, ca-ES)…
addLocale.customCodeHelp: Language in lowercase and subtags separated by hyphens. If it’s not in the list, paste the exact code you need (within the server’s character limit).
addLocale.flagLabel: Country code for flag (optional, ISO 3166-1, 2 letters)
addLocale.flagHelp: 2 ISO letters (e.g. ES) = flag emoji. More characters (e.g. CAT) = text badge in the panel and menu. You can leave it blank and the BCP-47 region will be used if applicable.
addLocale.showPublic: Show this language on the public menu (QR menu)
addLocale.needLocale: Choose a language from the list or enter a BCP-47 code.
addLocale.invalidLocale: Invalid code. Use at least language + region or another subtag (e.g. en-US, es-MX, zh-CN, fil-PH).
addLocale.alreadyBase: {{locale}} is already the menu’s base language.
addLocale.invalidFlag: Use 2–10 letters or numbers (e.g. ES, US, CAT). For a country emoji use the 2-letter ISO code.
addLocale.success: Language added. You can open the editor to refine the translations.

settings.title: Menu name & languages
settings.labelsHelp: Adjust how each language appears in the panel and on the public menu. Includes the default language{{sourceParen}}. The country code must be 2-letter ISO (US, ES, IT…). For ca-ES you can use ES (flag) or a label like CAT. Uncheck “Visible on public menu” to hide a language on the menu (it remains available in the editor).
settings.label: Label
settings.renameHelp: If you created it-IT by mistake but the content is English, rename it to en-US. Does not affect the default language{{sourceCode}}.
settings.invalidFlagForLocale: Invalid code for {{locale}}: 2–10 alphanumeric characters (e.g. ES, CAT).
settings.invalidRenameCode: The new code must be valid BCP-47 (e.g. en-US, es-MX, zh-CN).
